ready:
Stream is running.

On the viewing device, open Moonlight, select "{host}" and then "{app}".
sunshineMissing: Sunshine is not installed on this computer.
startFailed:
Stream could not be started.

Check that the Sunshine service is installed and that users are allowed to start it.
endConfirm:
End the stream?

The stream will disconnect and Sunshine will stop.
disconnected: Device Disconnected. If this was not on purpose, please reconnect it.
cableMissing: VB-CABLE is not installed. The microphone will not reach the stream.
mpvMissing: libmpv-2.dll was not found. The webcam overlay will not open. Run the installer again.
applied: Sunshine has been configured and the Start & End shortcuts were added to the desktop.
restarted: Sunshine was restarted to apply the changes.
adminRequired: Administrator permission is required to configure Sunshine.
